assets.purpose: 24 animation frames of the armored servant; replaces floating 3D armor
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied 6-column by 4-row red horned demon animation sprite atlas. Produce its armored variant for the same 16-bit FPS. Preserve EXACTLY the 24-cell 6x4 arrangement, canvas aspect ratio 3:2, character identity, horn shape, anatomy, every pose, facing direction, sequence, per-cell scale, foot placement and transparent margins. Row1 six front run frames; row2 three windup, two slash, one recovery; row3 hit then five death poses; row4 six rear run frames. Change only the costume: fit heavy weathered blue-grey BLACK IRON armor to the demon in ALL frames. Anatomical fitted ribbed breastplate with a small brass riveted centre seam, asymmetric layered shoulder guards, iron forearm bracers and greaves, a little torn charcoal waist cloth. Armor follows and bends with each pose, lies on the chest, looks three-dimensional and integrated into the sprite; never a floating rectangle or flat T-shirt. Retain exposed red flesh, bare claw hands, face and horns. In back frames show the fitted backplate. Use a restrained old-game palette, deliberate square pixel clusters and crisp stepped highlights, dark ink edges, cold steel edges against warm red skin. Strong recognisable silhouette. No smooth digital painting, blur, haze, bloom, background scene, floor, labels or cell grid. Genuine transparent background throughout all empty areas. Do not merge adjacent sprites. Nothing may cross a cell boundary. Sprite sheet only, no text.
